amendments: A1 (before any prediction): sampling rate was hard-coded 50 kHz; 44 of the first 102 cells are 200 kHz. Now read per sweep.

A2 (before any prediction, from the primary-session review): long-square rheobase counts only POSITIVE steps with a spike during the step (rebound after step end reported separately); short-square spike window = pulse + 20 ms.

A3 (before any prediction): short-square bracket is repeat-aware: hi = lowest amplitude with >=1 spiking repeat, lo = highest lower amplitude with no spiking repeat; repeat disagreement, non-monotonicity and censoring are flagged.
decision_note: overshoot = chosen amplitude / lowest amplitude actually observed to fire (hi); energy ~ I^2*T so energy overshoot = amplitude overshoot squared; cross-fit margin is the conformal-style quantile of train-fold log residuals, NOT a distribution-free guarantee on this heterogeneous panel
